## First plot

```{python}
#| echo: false

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 1, 200)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
ax.plot(x, np.sin(np.pi * x))
ax.set_xlabel("Normalized position")
ax.set_ylabel("Normalized displacement")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```
